title: Puzzle2d Brush Tool
description: Implement paint-style Brush tool for puzzle2d: offset slot hitboxes, compatible node preview, auto-flush on leave, Tab cycle candidates, flush-distance window measure.
summary: Fixed brush placements disappearing: guard fresh brush node/edge ids from play structural-delete resync (600ms TTL), sync committed fixture to all authoring panes immediately via puzzle2dSyncFixtureDescriptorToAllAuthoringPeers, longer quiet window on brush commit. applyBrushPlacementToFixture returns placed ids.
